product.description: Monoprice™30W USB‑C Fast Wall Charger30W Power Delivery | Fastest Charging for Phones, Tablets, Small Laptops | Auto‑Detects the Device to Provide Optimal Charging PowerThe Monoprice™ 30W USB‑C Fast Wall Charger is a cutting‑edge charging solution that delivers lightning‑fast charging speeds for a wide range of devices. Designed to provide the optimal power delivery for phones, tablets, and small laptops, this charger is perfect for users who demand quick and efficient charging.One of the standout features of this charger is its ability to support larger devices such as the iPhone Pro Max, iPad Pro/Air, and MacBook Air, which require 30W of power for maximum charging speed. Unlike standard chargers that offer only 20W, the Monoprice 30W charger ensures that your devices receive the power they need to charge at their fastest rate.The charger features both 30W and 20W charging modes, which can be automatically detected based on the connected device. This intelligent detection system ensures that each device receives the optimal level of charging power, maximizing efficiency and reducing charging time.With its broad compatibility, the Monoprice 30W charger is a one‑charger‑for‑all solution. It works seamlessly with various mobile devices from popular brands like Apple, Samsung, Google, and more. Whether you have an iPhone, iPad, Android phone, or other USB‑C enabled devices, this charger has you covered.In terms of speed, this charger truly excels. It is capable of charging an iPhone from 0 to up to 60% in just 30 minutes, providing a rapid power boost when you need it most. Whether you're rushing out the door or need a quick charge during a short break, this charger ensures you spend less time waiting and more time using your device.Designed with portability in mind, the Monoprice 30W charger boasts a slim and compact form factor. Its pocket‑size design allows for easy storage and transportation, making it an ideal companion for travels, work, or daily commutes. You can conveniently slip it into your bag or pocket without adding unnecessary bulk.Safety is a top priority with the Monoprice 30W charger. It is ETL‑certified, ensuring reliable and secure charging for your devices. This certification guarantees that the charger meets rigorous safety standards, giving you peace of mind while charging your valuable electronics.In conclusion, the Monoprice 30W USB‑C Fast Wall Charger offers a powerful and versatile charging solution. With its ability to deliver full charging speeds, broad compatibility, intelligent device detection, compact design, and ETL certification, it is a reliable and efficient choice for anyone seeking a fast and safe charging experience.
